## Review
- Correct: [pet.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet.ts:167) records a monotonic request version and guards primary `onload`/`onerror` plus fallback `onload`/`onerror` ([lines 174-200](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet.ts:174)). A genuine current fallback failure clears `loadedUrl`, allowing the same URL to be requested again. Targeted tests pass.
- Correct: Settings saves instance configuration and emits only to the owning pet window ([settings.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/settings.ts:53), [settings.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/settings.ts:828)); the window refreshes its cached instance, reloads the sprite, reapplies size, and renders ([pet-window.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-window.ts:267)). Popover updates also notify the active settings window ([popover.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/popover.ts:51)).
- Correct: Roaming keeps `TICK_MS` at 30 ms for active movement ([engine.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/roam/engine.ts:158)); system-window enumeration is now restricted to climb mode ([engine.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/roam/engine.ts:118), [environment.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/roam/environment.ts:81)). Static inspection retains native `startDragging` and per-window `set_hit_rect` click-through reporting ([pet-window.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-window.ts:316), [pet-window.ts](C:/sudy/github/DesktopPet/windows/src/pet-window.ts:357)).
- Note: No material findings. Remaining runtime gap: the test suite does not explicitly simulate a fallback request that starts, is superseded, then completes late; the callback guard is present and correct by inspection. WebView2 visibility, native dragging, and click-through also require a Windows/Tauri smoke test to validate OS-level behavior.
